question.text: The $d$ -electron configurations of $\mathrm{Cr}^{2+}, \mathrm{Mn}^{2+}, \mathrm{Fe}^{2+}$ and $\mathrm{Co}^{2+}$ are $d^{4}, d^{5}, d^{6}$ and $d^{7}$ respectively. Which one of the following will exhibit the lowest paramagnetic behaviour?  (Atomic no. $\mathrm{Cr}=24, \mathrm{Mn}=25, \mathrm{Fe}=26, \mathrm{Co}=27)$

solution.text: $\therefore$ Since $\mathrm{Co}^{2+}$ has lowest no. of unpaired electrons hence lowest paramagnetic behaviour is shown by $\left[\mathrm{Co}\left(\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}\right)_{6}\right]^{2+}$
